bifrost: none app-facing. Private chart drawing in springboard/src/shell/screentime/chart.rs and springboard/src/shell/battery.rs (Body::Graph in springboard/src/shell/list.rs)
summary: Swift Charts is a declarative SwiftUI API for marks, scales, axes and plots, with 2D, vectorized and 3D (macOS 26) charts. BifrOSt has no app-facing chart API in springboard/sdk/src or springboard/ui/src. Two shell-only drawers exist: the Screen Time bar chart and the battery 24-hour bar graph, both hard-wired to their own data. Nothing from the framework's mark, scale, plot, annotation or 3D surface model is available to apps.

features.bifrost: none. The sdk View trait (springboard/sdk/src/view/mod.rs:169) lets an app draw into a Surface by hand
features.note: no declarative chart container; apps would hand-draw every bar and label
bars are drawn only inside the Screen Time page; no app API
battery graph draws bins, not lines or areas (springboard/src/shell/battery.rs)

features.apple: PointMark, RectangleMark, RuleMark, PointPlot, RectanglePlot, RulePlot
features.note: no scatter, range or reference-line drawing in the SDK
no pie or donut drawing in springboard/sdk/src or springboard/ui/src

features.apple: VectorizedChartContent, AreaPlot, LinePlot, PointPlot, RectanglePlot, RulePlot, BarPlot, SectorPlot
features.note: no batched plot path; both shell charts take small fixed arrays

features.apple: ScaleType, ScaleDomain, AutomaticScaleDomain, ScaleRange, PositionScaleRange, PlotDimensionScaleRange
features.note: the domain is hard-coded per chart; no automatic domain inference and no log or sqrt scale

features.apple: AxisMarks, AxisMark, AxisTick, AxisGridLine, AxisValueLabel, AxisValue, AxisContentBuilder
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/screentime/chart.rs (right-hand axis label, hour and day labels)
features.note: axis labels are fixed in the shell (0, 6, 12, 18 h or weekday names); no grid lines or tick API
binning is written for the battery graph only, not reusable
no value callouts or labels attached to marks

features.feature: Chart proxy and plot area access
features.note: no way to map a pointer position to a data value, so no hover or selection on charts
the scroll view (springboard/sdk/src/view/scroll.rs) has no chart snap behaviour
no 3D chart or surface renderer in springboard/render/src

features.apple: Chart accessibility and localization (Swift Charts landing page)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/ax.rs (generic accessibility model), springboard/ui/src/format.rs (number and date formatting)
features.note: no chart-level accessibility summary, audio graph or chart-specific labels; the shell bars have no accessible values

gaps: No app-facing chart API: no Chart container, no marks, no scales, no axes, no plots in springboard/sdk or springboard/ui
The Screen Time bar chart and the battery graph are private shell drawers, not reusable by apps
No line, area, point, rectangle, rule or sector marks
No automatic scale domain, no axis grid lines or configurable ticks, no annotations
No chart proxy, so charts cannot respond to pointer position or selection
No 3D charts or surface plots (Chart3D is macOS 26.0 in Apple's docs)
No chart accessibility summaries or localized axis labels
docs/bifrost-ui.md has no dataviz or charts section, so the Apple parity record does not cover this framework
